headlines.title: Klient Launches Klient Insights: Live PSA Dashboards Inside Salesforce
headlines.summary: Klient today launched Klient Insights, a dashboard workspace built into Klient PSA, the Salesforce PSA for professional-services firms. Klient Insights puts margin, capacity, unbilled time and client health on one live screen, inside Salesforce, with no export and no spreadsheet.

headlines.title: Salesforce vs. ServiceNow: Here's What Revenue Trends Tell Investors About These Software Giants and Their Move to AI
headlines.summary: Salesforce commands roughly 2.8x the quarterly revenue, but ServiceNow has grown its top line faster over the past two years.

headlines.title: Is DocuSign (DOCU) Undervalued Following Its Expanded Salesforce Partnership?
headlines.summary: DocuSign (DOCU) just reset the conversation around its stock with an expanded Salesforce partnership that embeds its Intelligent Agreement Management platform directly into Salesforce, Agentforce, and Slack, tying agreements tightly to AI driven enterprise workflows. For DocuSign, that Salesforce news is landing on top of a strong run in the stock, with a 1-day share price return of 4.04%, a 7-day move of 9.19%, and a 90-day gain of 40.93% pointing to building momentum.

headlines.title: Exalate launches Australian hosting for Exalate Cloud, giving organisations the option to run integrations in-country
headlines.summary: Local hosting on Google Cloud in Sydney is available now, across every Exalate connector.ANTWERP, Belgium, Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Exalate, the integration solution for synchronising work across Jira, ServiceNow, Azure DevOps, Salesforce, Freshdesk and other platforms, announced Australian hosting for Exalate Cloud. Companies in Australia can now run their integrations on Google Cloud infrastructure in Sydney, with all Exalate connectors supported.

headlines.title: Salesforce vs. Palantir Technologies: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
headlines.summary: Salesforce trades at 13.7x forward earnings with $14.4B in free cash flow, while Palantir commands a 130.8x multiple on 56% revenue growth.

description: Salesforce, Inc. provides customer relationship management technology services that connect companies and customers together in the United States, Europe, and the Asia Pacific. The company offers Agentforce, which enables customers to build, deploy, and manage enterprise-grade, autonomous AI agents at scale, enabling humans and agents to work together; Agentforce Sales, an integrated platform that brings together the power of humans with AI agents to help sales teams for selling, managing, and automating entire sales processes; Agentforce Service, which enables companies in every industry to bring all of their customer, employee, IT, and field service needs onto one integrated AI-powered platform; Data 360, a data engine that gives AI agents their context and serves as the foundation for how customers unify service offerings, making their data actionable for both humans and agents; Informatica, an AI-powered data management platform that enables customers to discover, integrate, govern, and deliver trusted data at scale across hybrid and multi-cloud environments; and Slack, a conversational interface for the agentic enterprise where people and agents work together, connecting knowledge, actions, and data in real time. It also provides marketing platforms; commerce services, which empower shopping experiences across various customer touchpoints; integration and analytics solutions; Salesforce Starter, a suite for small and medium-sized businesses that brings sales, service, marketing, and commerce together; and a field service solution that enables companies to connect service agents, dispatchers, and mobile employees through one centralized platform to schedule and dispatch work, as well as track and manage jobs. It serves financial services, healthcare and life sciences, manufacturing, automotive, and government sectors. Salesforce, Inc. was incorporated in 1999 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
